goal: Play a full round and use the new feature: Visual and feel pass (art, juice, readability; no gameplay rules change): In ShopUi.client.luau, scale-tween the panel in on open with a whoosh (GameAssets.play) and increment a shop_opened counter. On a successful buy, play the buy sound, flash the row green, tween a level bar fill, and increment shop_purchases. Buying must use the same server validation as the pads. If the player has too little cash, shake the row and play an error buzz. Use the existing GameAssets and UiTheme.. It has on-screen UI: use it like a player, through its buttons (`ui` + press): open its panel and press its action buttons (claim, buy, equip), and check what changed
summary: The playtester opened the shop with the SHOP button and bought four items: Dropper 2, Speed 1, Silver Ore and Dropper 3. The HUD confirmed each purchase ('Upgraded: ...'), and the probe shows shop_opened=1 and shop_purchases=4 with no server errors. The too-little-cash path was only partly confirmed: the Buy press at step 4 fired without a purchase, but presses at steps 7 and 9 did not register at all.

bugs.title: Buy button on unaffordable shop rows sometimes does not register a press
bugs.evidence: At step 7 (Card_tier_gold, click at 739,744) and step 9 (Card_mult1, click at 739,640), the tool reported 'button did NOT fire'. Cash was well below the price in both cases (167 vs $300 at step 9). Step 4 (Card_dropper3 at $53 vs $150) did fire. This suggests the row shake or error-buzz feedback may not be reachable on every row, or the button is blocked, clipped or moved while the row tweens or shakes. The shake and buzz could not be confirmed from the trace.
